Made Vite dev frontend use --strictPort because Tauri devUrl is fixed to 127.0.0.1:1420. This prevents Vite from silently moving to 1421 and leaving the Tauri window pointed at the wrong URL when port 1420 is occupied.

Fixed GUI default generated vault path for Tauri dev runtime cwd. The default now points to ../../../test-vaults/generated/phase3-base.kdbx, matching the src-tauri working directory used by tauri dev and backend command tests.

Added ActiveView navigation state and redesigned the GUI shell into a top unlock/session bar, left sidebar, and view panels for Browse, Groups, Audit, Write, and Status. Existing element IDs and handlers were preserved for browse/search/detail/copy/group/audit/write/status flows.
